newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast late prods steady to lower with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast late prods steady to lower with NYMEX.

text.p: Spot prices for U.S. West Coast crude oil products were steady to lower, taking their cue from weaker crude and heating oil futures in late Wednesday trade.
Traders said warmer weather and high production allowed a build in heating oil supplies last week.

Weekly data from the American Petroleum Institute (API) and U.S. Energy Department showed distillate supplies, which include heating oil, grew by nearly 4 million barrels. The build eased worries of meager supplies going into the cold weather season in the U.S. Northeast.
